data.one_liner: A lightweight generic provider using InheritedWidget to expose values in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: It offers Provider, Providers, Consumer widgets and extensions to expose and retrieve objects via InheritedWidget. It simplifies dependency exposure without writing custom InheritedWidgets.
use_when: You need simple state or object sharing without extra boilerplate
You prefer a minimalistic alternative to the official provider package
avoid_when: You require advanced features like scoped providers, auto-dispose, or code‑generation
You need built‑in support for state‑notifiers or async providers
strengths: Very small and easy to understand
No code‑generation or additional tooling required
weaknesses: Limited feature set compared to more mature packages
Less community support and fewer extensions

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official, widely used, more features and community support

alternatives.name: flutter_riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a robust, compile‑time safe provider system with many extensions
